state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball and the robot is now resting close to it, facing it.

- **Search:** The ball wasn't visible from the starting spot. A red lid on a container nearby turned out not to be it. I walked about 1.5 m forward, then moved left into the open part of the room. From there, a look around showed the ball on the floor near the TV stand.
- **Approach:** I walked toward it, turned about 60° right to face it, and took a short step forward. The last look before resting showed the ball centred about 15–20 cm in front of the feet.
- **Final check:** Crouching into rest turned the robot about 9° to the left. The last image still shows the ball at the bottom centre of the view, right in front of it. Someone is measuring the distance with a tape measure.

The robot said "I found the red ball" out loud, and its motors are now off.
